nodes.name: Linear Regression Model
nodes.description: A supervised model predicting a continuous target as a linear combination of input features, fitted by minimising the squared error between predictions and observations.
nodes.visual_hint: Fit a regression line to scattered points; drag the line to see the error.

nodes.name: Mean Squared Error Cost
nodes.description: The mean squared error cost averaging squared residuals between predictions and targets, a convex objective whose minimisation defines least-squares regression.

nodes.name: Batch Gradient Descent
nodes.description: An iterative optimiser updating parameters along the negative gradient of the cost, using the entire training batch to compute each gradient step.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate gradient descent stepping down a cost surface.

nodes.name: Stochastic & Mini-batch GD
nodes.description: Gradient-descent variants updating parameters from one example (stochastic) or a small subset (mini-batch), trading gradient noise for faster, scalable updates.
nodes.name_zh: 随机与小批量梯度下降

nodes.name: Normal Equations
nodes.description: A closed-form solution for linear regression obtained by setting the cost's gradient to zero and solving the resulting linear system without iteration.

nodes.name: Feature Scaling & Learning Rate
nodes.description: Normalising features to comparable ranges and choosing an appropriate learning rate, both of which speed and stabilise gradient-descent convergence.

nodes.name: Logistic Regression
nodes.description: A probabilistic linear classifier modelling the probability of a binary class with the logistic function, fitted by maximising the likelihood of the labels.
nodes.visual_hint: Plot the logistic decision boundary separating two classes.

nodes.name: Sigmoid & Decision Boundary
nodes.description: The sigmoid function mapping real scores to probabilities in (0,1), inducing a linear decision boundary where the predicted probability equals one half.
nodes.visual_hint: Plot the sigmoid mapping scores to probabilities and its decision boundary.

nodes.name: Logistic MLE & Gradient
nodes.description: Estimating logistic-regression parameters by maximising the log-likelihood of the labels, whose gradient drives the gradient-ascent or descent updates.
nodes.name_zh: 逻辑回归极大似然估计与梯度

nodes.name: Newton's Method
nodes.description: A second-order optimisation method using the Hessian to take curvature-aware steps, converging in few iterations for logistic regression.

nodes.name: Softmax Regression
nodes.description: Softmax regression generalising logistic regression to multiple classes by producing a normalised probability distribution over the class scores.
nodes.visual_hint: Show softmax turning class scores into a probability distribution.

nodes.name: Exponential Family
nodes.description: A family of distributions sharing a canonical exponential form, unifying common distributions and providing the foundation for generalised linear models.

nodes.name: Generalized Linear Models
nodes.description: Generalised linear models relating a linear predictor to a response from the exponential family through a link function, generalising ordinary regression.

nodes.name: Generative vs Discriminative
nodes.description: The contrast between generative models that learn the joint distribution p(x,y) and discriminative models that learn the conditional p(y|x) directly.

nodes.name: Gaussian Discriminant Analysis
nodes.description: Gaussian discriminant analysis, a generative classifier modelling each class's features as a multivariate Gaussian and applying Bayes' rule to classify.

nodes.name: Naive Bayes
nodes.description: A generative classifier assuming features are conditionally independent given the class, enabling simple, scalable estimation popular for text classification.

nodes.name: Laplace Smoothing
nodes.description: Laplace (add-one) smoothing adding pseudocounts to probability estimates so that unseen feature-class combinations receive nonzero probability.

nodes.name: Functional & Geometric Margins
nodes.description: Functional and geometric margins measuring a classifier's confidence and the signed distance from examples to the decision boundary, central to SVMs.

nodes.name: Optimal Margin Classifier
nodes.description: The optimal margin classifier, a convex primal optimisation finding the hyperplane that maximises the geometric margin to the nearest training points.
nodes.visual_hint: Drag points to show the max-margin hyperplane and its support vectors.

nodes.name: Lagrange Duality & KKT
nodes.description: Lagrange duality reformulating a constrained optimisation via its dual, with the KKT conditions characterising optimal primal-dual solutions for SVMs.
nodes.name_zh: 拉格朗日对偶性与 KKT 条件

nodes.name: SVM Dual Problem
nodes.description: The SVM dual problem expressing the optimisation in terms of inner products between examples, exposing support vectors and enabling kernels.

nodes.name: Kernel Trick
nodes.description: The kernel trick computing inner products in a high-dimensional feature space implicitly, letting linear algorithms learn nonlinear decision boundaries.
nodes.visual_hint: Lift non-separable points into a higher dimension where they separate.

nodes.name: Valid Kernels (Mercer)
nodes.description: Mercer's condition characterising valid kernels as functions yielding positive semidefinite Gram matrices, guaranteeing a corresponding feature space.

nodes.name: Soft Margin & Slack
nodes.description: A soft-margin SVM introducing slack variables and a penalty parameter to tolerate misclassification, balancing margin width against training errors.

nodes.name: SMO Algorithm
nodes.description: Sequential minimal optimisation, a coordinate-ascent algorithm solving the SVM dual by analytically optimising pairs of Lagrange multipliers at a time.

nodes.name: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
nodes.description: The bias-variance tradeoff decomposing generalisation error into bias from oversimplification and variance from sensitivity to the training sample.
nodes.visual_hint: Plot training and validation error against model complexity.

nodes.name: Regularization (L1/L2)
nodes.description: Adding an L1 or L2 penalty on parameters to the cost, discouraging large weights to reduce overfitting and, for L1, inducing sparse solutions.
nodes.visual_hint: Show L1 and L2 penalties shrinking fitted coefficients.

nodes.name: Cross-Validation
nodes.description: Cross-validation estimating generalisation by repeatedly training on subsets and validating on held-out folds, used for model selection and tuning.

nodes.name: VC Dimension & Bounds
nodes.description: The VC dimension measuring a hypothesis class's capacity as the largest set it can shatter, bounding the gap between training and true error.

nodes.name: Model & Feature Selection
nodes.description: Choosing among models and feature subsets to balance fit and complexity, using validation performance and selection procedures to avoid overfitting.

nodes.name: Neural Networks
nodes.description: Neural networks composing layers of weighted sums and nonlinear activations to learn flexible, nonlinear mappings from inputs to outputs.
nodes.visual_hint: Diagram a layered network of weighted sums and activations.

nodes.name: Backpropagation
nodes.description: Backpropagation efficiently computing gradients of the loss with respect to all weights by applying the chain rule backward through the network.

nodes.name: K-Means Clustering
nodes.description: K-means clustering partitioning data into K clusters by alternately assigning points to the nearest centroid and recomputing centroids to minimise inertia.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate K-means alternating assignment and centroid updates.

nodes.name: EM Algorithm
nodes.description: Expectation-maximisation, an iterative method for maximum-likelihood estimation with latent variables, alternating expected-completion and parameter-update steps.

nodes.name: Gaussian Mixtures via EM
nodes.description: Gaussian mixture models representing data as a weighted mixture of Gaussians, fitted by expectation-maximisation to perform soft probabilistic clustering.

nodes.name: Principal Component Analysis
nodes.description: Principal component analysis reducing dimensionality by projecting data onto orthogonal directions of greatest variance, the leading eigenvectors of the covariance.
nodes.visual_hint: Project a 2-D cloud onto its principal component directions.

nodes.name: Independent Component Analysis
nodes.description: Independent component analysis separating a multivariate signal into statistically independent, non-Gaussian source components, as in blind source separation.

nodes.name: Markov Decision Processes
nodes.description: Markov decision processes formalising sequential decision-making under uncertainty with states, actions, transition probabilities, rewards, and a discount factor.

nodes.name: Value & Policy Iteration
nodes.description: Value iteration and policy iteration, dynamic-programming algorithms computing optimal policies for a known MDP via the Bellman equations.
nodes.visual_hint: Iterate values and policy on an MDP gridworld until convergence.

nodes.name: Q-Learning
nodes.description: Q-learning, a model-free, off-policy algorithm learning optimal action-value estimates from sampled transitions without knowing the environment's dynamics.
nodes.visual_hint: Update a Q-table as an agent explores a gridworld.

nodes.name: Value Function Approximation
nodes.description: Value function approximation generalising value estimates across large or continuous state spaces using parameterised functions like linear models or networks.
